newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Islamists face jail over Allah tattoo killing.
newsitem.headline: Turk Islamists face jail over Allah tattoo killing.

text.p: A Turkish prosecutor on Friday demanded jail sentences for two gunmen who killed a well-known barman because of the "Allah" tattoo on his shoulder, state-run Anatolian news agency said.
It said the defendants confessed to killing barman Oguz Atak in May after arguing with him over his tattoo as he walked his dog in an exclusive Istanbul district.
They told police earlier they had seen Atak on a television programme and were angered that someone working in a bar would wear a tattoo depicting the name Allah in Arabic script.
According to Anatolian, one gunman faced 24 to 30 years in prison for killing the barman, while the second was likely to be given 15 years as an accomplice.
Turkey has been debating religion's role in public life since the Islamist Welfare Party came to power last year.
Welfare leader and modern Turkey's first Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan resigned on Wednesday after a row with the country's strictly secularist military over rising religious activism.
A defence lawyer told the court the defendants were brought up under strict religious and moral rules which led them to carry out the killing.
